Why go: a luxury motor yacht from the north coast

The Prestige is a 50 ft (15.2 m) Prestige 500 motor yacht, a French-built cruising yacht with 2 double cabins, each with its own bathroom, an air-conditioned lounge and dining area, an outdoor lounge and a teak sun deck. It departs from Bangrak pier near Big Buddha Beach, so guests staying in Bophut, Choeng Mon or Chaweng are only a short drive away.

Because a motor yacht is faster than a sailing catamaran, the Prestige can reach places further out in a day. The 4-hour routes go to Pig Island and Koh Tan or to a beach on Koh Phangan. The 8-hour routes reach Koh Tao and the three linked islets of Koh Nang Yuan, or Ang Thong Marine Park from 16 December.

Who it suits, and who should choose something else

It suits couples, honeymooners and small groups who want privacy, air conditioning and a proper interior, and anyone who wants to see Koh Tao in a day without the crowds of the public ferry and day-tour boats. The cabins make it comfortable for a nap between stops.

It is one of the most expensive ways to spend a day on the water in our fleet. Groups over 13 cannot be taken. If you mainly want to swim and snorkel, a sailing catamaran gives a similar day for less than half the price; see our catamaran charter guide. For a shared trip to Koh Tao, our Koh Tao and Koh Nang Yuan day trip costs a fraction of a private yacht.

Good to know

  • Food, drinks and hotel transfers are not in the base price. Tell us what you want when you book and we confirm the quote before you pay for extras.
  • Koh Nang Yuan bans plastic bottles and charges a landing fee of 250 THB per person. Fins are not allowed in the shallow bays there.
  • Ang Thong is closed 1 November–15 December every year; choose another route in that window.
  • The open-water run to Koh Tao is the longest route in our fleet and can be lumpy in the northeast monsoon. The captain may switch to a sheltered route on rough days; check sea conditions.

Combine it with

Pair a sunset cruise with dinner at Fisherman's Village, a short drive from Bangrak, or plan a special trip with our honeymoon guide. All our yachts are compared on the yacht charter page.
